name: spotify-review-insights-dashboard

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend

description: Two independent services deployed together on Vercel (see vercel.json). Each has its own package.json and lockfile, so Vercel installs each service's dependencies in its own folder.
